jobs.title: Senior Deal Desk Manager
jobs.jd_full:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Senior Deal Desk Manager is a senior individual contributor role responsible for how Legion prices, structures, approves, and contracts global deals across every region Legion sells into. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation and scale it into a fast, compliant, AI-native function — through better systems and automation, not more headcount.

The ideal candidate has built Deal Desk operations from scratch at an early-stage or growth-stage SaaS company and knows what to standardize, what to automate, and what to leave flexible. They work AI-first: when a process is slow, their first move is to build an agent, a tool, or an automation. This person will serve as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Client Management, helping to streamline quote-to-close workflows, enforce pricing governance, and accelerate revenue realization.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

  • Own deal structuring for complex new business, expansion, and renewal deals, partnering with sales leaders on creative structures that protect margin and policy.
  • Own the approval matrix, discount guardrails, non-standard terms policy, and SLAs, with accountability for approval cycle time and quote accuracy.
  • Support global deals end to end, including multi-currency pricing, multiple contracting entities, regional terms and tax considerations, and approval cycles that span time zones.
  • Partner with Legal and Finance on contract standards, regional contracting requirements (data protection terms, local entity paper, currency/FX policy), revenue recognition alignment, and the order-to-cash handoff.
  • Design Deal Desk workflows with AI at the core — for example, automated deal pre-screening against pricing and packaging policy, AI-generated deal summaries for approvers, and AI-assisted redline review against Legal’s playbook.
  • Build and iterate working tools — pricing calculators, quoting tools, and approval automations — using AI-assisted development.
  • Set guardrails for AI in deal workflows, including human-in-the-loop approvals, appropriate data handling, and a clear audit trail.
  • Own and evolve Legion’s quoting and contracting stack (CPQ, CLM, DocuSign) with Salesforce as the system of record, including tools built in-house, and ensure workflows handle currencies, entities, and regional templates without manual workarounds.
  • Develop reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and executive leadership visibility into discount trends, packaging adherence, approval turnaround times, and the impact of automation.
  • Present deal analysis and insights directly in executive pricing reviews and forecast discussions.
  • Partner closely with RevOps, Product Marketing, and Finance to operationalize pricing and packaging changes. Build the deal calculators, edge-case rules, and sales playbooks that bring new pricing to life in the field.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

    • 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations within B2B SaaS companies, including 3+ years owning Deal Desk operations end to end.
    • Demonstrated experience building Deal Desk processes from the ground up at an early-stage or growth-stage company, with the ability to walk through what was built, in what order, and what you would do differently.
    • Hands-on AI practitioner who has used AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Agentforce) to automate real Deal Desk or RevOps work, with an example to share.
    • Hands-on experience structuring and contracting international SaaS deals across multiple regions, currencies, and legal entities.
    • Deep expertise in SaaS pricing — subscription, usage-based, consumption-based, and hybrid models — along with discount governance and contracting best practices.
    • Experience implementing CPQ and CLM systems; strong modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets.
    • Proven ability to influence without authority across Sales, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership, including saying no to senior sellers while keeping the relationship intact.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

    • Experience launching AI, agentic, or data product SKUs, or partner and marketplace deal structures.
    • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
    • Experience in WFM, HCM, or enterprise SaaS selling to retail, hospitality, or healthcare.
    • Operates with a builder’s mindset — proactive, resourceful, and eager to create clarity from ambiguity with a high degree of independence.
    • Strong personal ownership, high integrity, and a focus on outcomes over activity.
    • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
    • Thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment and embraces change with enthusiasm.
    • Flexibility to cover urgent deal approvals across time zones, especially at quarter-end.

SALARY RANGE:

Base Salary Range $100,000 - $140,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.

Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.

Benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Health Benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Parental Leave
  • Equity
  • Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly Lunch on Legion

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“Legion”, “we”, “us” and “our”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

  1. Types of Personal Information We Handle

    We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

    • Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.
    • Professional or employment-related information, including:
      • Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.
      • Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
    • Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.
    • Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.
    • Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.

  2. How We Use Personal Information

    We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.

  3. With Whom We Share Personal Information

    We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):

    • Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.
    • Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.
    • Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.
    • Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.
    • Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.
  4. How to Contact Us About this Policy – If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion.co.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Universal KYC (MetaMask Passport)
jobs.jd_full:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About MetaMask

MetaMask is building a future where users can unlock the full product stack through a single, seamless identity experience, enabling access to all features with trust, safety, and minimal friction.

Today, identity verification is fragmented across several product and onboarding experiences. Users are repeatedly asked to verify themselves across different services, creating unnecessary friction, inconsistent outcomes, and degraded trust.

Universal KYC (UKYC) is a new initiative to solve this problem by creating a single, reusable identity layer across MetaMask. At the centre of this is MetaMask Passport, a product designed to enable users to verify once and unlock multiple experiences across the MetaMask ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of platform and product experience. You will define the primitives, standards, and user journeys that make identity verification seamless, privacy-conscious, and globally compliant.

What you’ll do

You will own the vision and roadmap for Universal KYC and MetaMask Passport, defining how a reusable identity layer unlocks the broader MetaMask product stack. You will build the underlying identity platform, creating scalable verification primitives and standards that can be adopted across products. In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. You will drive adoption across MetaMask by partnering closely with internal teams to integrate a consistent identity layer, while balancing privacy, trust, and global regulatory requirements. Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes.

What we are looking for:

  • Proven experience building or scaling identity verification (IDV), KYC, or onboarding products
  • Strong background in fintech, ideally with exposure to Web3
  • Hands-on experience working with identity verification providers (IDV vendors) such as Sumsub, Veriff, Onfido, Persona, or Stripe Identity
  • Familiarity with compliance workflows, including KYC, KYB, and customer due diligence (CDD) processes
  • Track record of delivering platform products adopted across multiple teams
  • Ability to operate across both technical systems and user experience

What Success looks like:

  • Increased KYC completion rates and reduced onboarding friction
  • Reduced time-to-first-transaction across KYC-gated flows
  • Increased reuse of verified identity across products
  • Improved transaction success rate through consistent verification outcomes
  • Strong user trust with minimal friction and compliant execution

Attributes that will make you stand out

  • First-principles thinker with strong product judgment
  • Deep user empathy with a focus on reducing friction and cognitive load
  • Strong understanding of trust, privacy, and compliance trade-offs
  • Clear, structured communicator who drives alignment and momentum
  • High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguity

Why This Role Matters

Universal KYC is a foundational unlock for MetaMask, enabling users to move from fragmented, repetitive identity verification to a seamless, reusable experience across the entire product stack. It establishes a scalable, privacy-conscious identity layer that strengthens user trust while meeting global compliance requirements. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of access, trust, and growth, critical to unlocking the next phase of MetaMask’s evolution.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)

$130,000—$187,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.

MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Investing
jobs.jd_full:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Investing areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Portugal.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Global Senior Sales Operations Growth Specialist
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Sales Operations Growth Specialist to join our Global Sales team. This role is for someone who likes making outreach engines run smoothly.

You’ll bring clarity, speed and own our sales engagement stack to grow reach rates across every market while taking the day-to-day tool complexity off Local Sales teams. If you enjoy building clean workflows, testing what converts and seeing your work move the needle every week, you’ll fit right in.

How will you make an impact?

  • Reach rate: Builds its own dashboards from day one and owns the reach rate country meeting: clear agenda and follow-up of the numbers.

  • Talkdesk: Ring group and number-sharing strategy; watches for burned numbers; every new joiner has a licence in the right ring group from day one. Partner with the tools team to ensure delivery.

  • Call fevers: Builds the list, rotation, assignment and sequence for each call fever with Local Sales Ops, using the BL leaders’ preparation skill.

  • Sequences and WhatsApp: One sequence library, A/B tests and reply rates; explains the sequence strategy to the markets; makes the changes within SLA, call fevers included.

  • DP Meet: Reviews scheduling with Marketing and leads Dynamic Assignees: pool rules by tenure (for example, from 6 months a rep joins the DP Meet pool) and one-off exceptions.

  • One update process: Talkdesk, DP Meet and WhatsApp follow the HiBob people-change process that Macarena coordinates, the same way as Salesforce.

  • Sales no-show: Reduce sales no-show reminders based on AI tools and processes. .

How success is measured: keep improving reach rate and keep testing new strategies and channels.

  • Reach rate per market and channel, month over month

  • Sequence changes live within SLA

  • New joiners ready in Talkdesk and DP Meet from day one

  • Less Local Sales Ops time spent on the tools

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

  • 2–6 years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or business development.

  • Educational background in STEM or business-related fields.

  • Fluent in English; Spanish, Portuguese, Polish, or other languages are a plus.

  • Proven track record optimizing sequences, testing messaging and cadences across channels, with hands-on experience managing sales engagement tools (such as Talkdesk, email/call sequence platforms, WhatsApp Business and scheduling tools).

  • A track record of delivering projects end-to-end - from problem definition to implementation.

  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate data into actionable decisions.

  • Confident working with data — analyzing large datasets to spot trends, issues, and opportunities.

  • Curious and hands-on with AI tools and automated workflows

  • Comfortable collaborating across teams and working with multiple stakeholders.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar.

  • Basic working knowledge of SQL or similar tools to extract and manipulate data.

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Giuliana to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A live exercise, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Final Interview – A final conversation with another Senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

jobs.jd_full:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Productions is the 'done for you' managed services wing of ElevenLabs made for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts to unlock human-edited dubs, audiobooks, and more in 15+ languages directly on the ElevenLabs platform.

Here are a few recent projects Productions has helped bring to life:

  • Dubbing for some of the world's biggest creators (DudePerfect, Lex Fridman, Andrew Huberman), media businesses (Headspace) and broadcasters (Mediaset)

  • Audiobook production for leading publishers and digital storytelling platforms

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Security Outcomes
jobs.jd_full:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager, Security Outcomes to join Anduril’s security outcomes team. You will champion
the connective layer between the offensive security engineers who find security issues and the teams responsible for
resolving them.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own the post engagement outcomes for findings from internal and external offensive security
engagements. You will identify or communicate with the affected teams, contribute to vulnerability policy, establish
accountable owners, surface blockers, coordinate retesting, and maintain reliable status through verified closure.
You will also partner with Offensive Security leadership on testing intake, active assessments, dependencies, and
improvements. Offensive Security owns test strategy, technical findings, and validation verdicts; Product Security
and affected engineering teams own remediation. You contribute to the pipeline connecting them.
This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. It requires technical fluency, operating judgment, and
persistent influence across teams as your work impacts Anduril as a whole.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own findings from internal and external offensive security engagements after delivery, from handoff through verified closure.
  • Identify affected teams, establish accountable remediation owners, and make sure they have the technical context needed to act.
  • Track remediation progress, run recurring reviews, surface blockers, and escalate overdue or high risk issues.
  • Coordinate retesting with Offensive Security and close findings only when fixes are verified.
  • Partner with Offensive Security leadership on testing intake, active assessments, and dependencies.Maintain a clear view of open findings, ownership, status, and risk, and report on remediation outcomes and recurring issues to engineering and leadership.
  • Contribute to vulnerability policy, remediation targets, and exception handling, and improve the processes connecting testing to remediation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of technical project or program leadership, security delivery, or comparable cross functional engineering program experience, including 2+ years supporting cybersecurity, penetration testing, Product
  • Security, vulnerability management, or security engineering.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to understand attack paths, vulnerability impact, remediation constraints, and validation evidence, and to know when a decision requires a security engineer.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, operating discipline, attention to detail, and ability to maintain trusted status across a high volume portfolio.
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience operating penetration testing, red team, application security, PSIRT, vulnerability remediation, or security assurance programs.
  • Experience in a security consultancy, internal offensive security function, or continuously shipping product organization.
  • Familiarity with CVSS, CWE, coordinated disclosure, risk exceptions, secure development practices, and vulnerability management workflows.

US Salary Range

$114,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril’s total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We’ve observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:

    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency’s authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender’s email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril’s candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: IT Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About IT

The IT team enables Affirmers to work securely and efficiently. We manage internal devices, networks, and systems, ensuring employees can collaborate and perform at their best. Our team supports onboarding, troubleshooting, and scaling technology across locations. We focus on usability, reliability, and security to maintain a productive work environment. The IT team ensures that Affirmers have the tools and support they need—wherever they work.

About the role

As an IT Product Manager, you’ll help Affirmers embrace new ways of working and get more value from the technology they use every day. Partnering with IT leadership and teams across Affirm, you’ll translate employee needs into product priorities, shape technology roadmaps and lifecycle decisions, and drive adoption of collaboration, productivity, and emerging AI-powered capabilities.

What You’ll Do

We are looking for a collaborative, adaptable IT Product Manager to help Affirmers work more effectively by shaping how we manage, use, and adopt collaboration, productivity, and AI-powered workplace technologies.

  • You will partner with IT leadership to define and manage priorities for Affirm’s collaboration and productivity tools, including Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and emerging AI-powered technologies.
  • You will turn employee needs, business priorities, and technical constraints into clear requirements, practical solutions, and actionable roadmaps that guide technology improvements.
  • You will help guide the technology lifecycle, from evaluating new solutions and developing business cases to optimizing existing investments, supporting vendor renewals, and recommending when to consolidate or retire tools.
  • You will lead the rollout and adoption of new tools, features, and AI-powered capabilities, partnering with Internal Communications, business leaders, and employee champions to help Affirmers navigate change with confidence.
  • You will connect Affirmers with practical guidance, self-service resources, and learning opportunities—leveraging vendor expertise, existing materials, and on-demand options—to help them build confidence and get more value from workplace technology.
  • You will define success measures, use employee feedback, adoption data, and support trends to evaluate outcomes, and recommend improvements that enhance the employee experience and inform technology priorities.
  • You will partner with IT Engineering, Security, Legal, Procurement, and vendors to deliver solutions that balance employee needs, business value, technical feasibility, cost, and risk.

 

What We Look For

You bring hands-on technology experience, a product mindset, and a people-first approach to solving problems, collaborating across teams, and helping others embrace change.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in IT product or program management, workplace technology, technology-focussed organizational change management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
  • You have experience identifying and delivering improvements to employee workflows through enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms, such as Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, or similar technologies, and are eager to apply that same approach to emerging AI capabilities.
  • You have experience gathering stakeholder needs, defining requirements, prioritizing opportunities, and developing actionable plans or roadmaps for technology solutions.
  • You have experience leading technology rollouts, organizational change initiatives, or employee adoption programs that help people confidently embrace new tools and ways of working.
  • You communicate clearly with different audiences and have experience identifying, organizing, and sharing resources that help employees understand and adopt workplace technologies.
  • You use data, employee feedback, and support trends to evaluate technology adoption, measure outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • You build effective relationships across technical and business teams, using sound judgment to balance competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions without direct authority.

Equity Grade - 4

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager, Activation
jobs.jd_full:
At Curai, we believe that access to high-quality healthcare is a fundamental human right, not a privilege. Our mission is to radically transform healthcare by harnessing the power of artificial intelligence and clinical expertise to make care more affordable, accessible, and effective for everyone. 

Lead Product Managers at Curai are force multipliers who tackle our most consequential product problems, shape product direction, and elevate the organization around them. 

As Lead Product Manager, Activation, you’ll own the first-use product experience, from the user’s first message through clinical handoff, across direct-to-consumer and partner channels. You’ll identify and remove barriers to conversion, improve how users discover and engage with non-clinical services, and shape new opportunities to help people get the care and support they need.

Who you are

  • A systems thinker who connects consumer behavior, acquisition, clinical delivery, technology, and business performance, anticipating consequences across boundaries.
  • A strategic product thinker who identifies high-impact growth opportunities, reframes difficult problems, and develops a point of view that changes product direction.
  • An expert in consumer activation, with a deep understanding of acquisition funnels, activation, conversion, retention, and experimentation.
  • A hands-on contributor who creates clarity in ambiguity, challenges weak assumptions, and builds alignment without avoiding difficult disagreements.
  • A rigorous quantitative thinker who interrogates data, distinguishes evidence from conjecture, and uses it to challenge assumptions and make better decisions.
  • A precise written and verbal communicator who makes complex decisions, reasoning, and requirements clear
  • A thoughtful builder with exacting standards, who cares as much about the quality of the experience as the outcomes it drives.
  • A relentlessly curious builder who seeks out new ideas, challenges their own thinking, and continually raises the quality of their work and the work of those around them.

What you’ll do

IMPACT

  • Own and continuously improve the first-use product journey, from the user’s first interaction through clinical handoff, increasing conversion rates for all DTC and partner funnels.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on acquisition landing pages and the transition into the product experience, ensuring acquisition strategy and first-use conversion are informed by shared evidence and performance data.
  • Lead consequential, cross-functional initiatives that deliver sustained improvements in conversion and business performance.
  • Shape first-use experiences that establish the foundations for long-term engagement, identifying and improving early behaviors that predict retention and continued product use.
  • Develop an evidence-grounded direction for your product area, identifying which opportunities warrant investment and which to exclude.
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities to extend the first-use experience into valuable non-clinical services, such as appointment booking, cost estimation, and healthcare administration.
  • Shape first-use journeys for retail, health plan, and health system partners, balancing channel-specific requirements with a scalable, coherent product experience.

 

CRAFT

  • Develop product frameworks, requirements, and approaches that bring clarity to complex, interconnected problems and enable multiple teams to execute independently.
  • Make dependencies, assumptions, and decisions explicit, enabling coordinated execution and adapting plans within shared priorities and commitments.
  • Design and evaluate growth experiments with clear hypotheses, appropriate measurement, and an understanding of statistical and practical significance.
  • Independently analyze product data, including funnels, cohorts, channel performance, and experiments, to diagnose conversion barriers, evaluate competing hypotheses, and substantiate product and investment decisions.
  • Define AI product behavior, evaluation criteria, and safe clinician handoffs with Design, Engineering, AI, and Clinical partners.
  • Define how product capabilities, workflows, and data fit together, identifying structural gaps and shaping scalable solutions.
  • Partner with Clinical Product leadership to ensure effective transitions into clinical workflows and longitudinal care, respecting clinical eligibility, safety, and operational constraints.
  • Identify and escalate systemic obstacles to quality and velocity, making it easier for teams to deliver excellent work independently.
  • Combine consumer insight, behavioral evidence, and technical understanding to shape product choices and resolve uncertainty.

 

TEAM

  • Raise the quality of product thinking, quantitative reasoning, and execution beyond personal initiatives through exemplary work and critique.
  • Partner with Product leadership to increase quality and velocity.
  • Develop peers’ judgment and independence through coaching and mentorship.

What you’ll need

  • 8+ years of demonstrable experience leading consumer product growth, with sustained, measurable improvements in activation, conversion, or other consequential growth outcomes.
  • Deep practical experience with product analytics, funnel optimization, cohort analysis, and experimentation, including independently conducting analyses and translating findings into product decisions.
  • Strong analytical and written judgment, demonstrated through artifacts that drove investment and execution.
  • Experience building products that use AI or LLMs, with an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and evaluation approaches.
  • Sustained evidence of driving meaningful user outcomes and strategic influence beyond your directly owned work.
  • Examples of reframing consequential problems, resolving uncertainty across boundaries, and enabling others to deliver more effectively.
  • Experience aligning marketing, technical, operational, and business partners around difficult trade-offs.
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry is preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, GTM Programs
jobs.jd_full:

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Go-to-Market (GTM)  Programs team enables a high-performance sales team by leveraging technology, automation, and best-in-class methodologies to sharpen how we go to market, improve forecasting accuracy, and maximize sales efficiency & effectiveness.

The Senior Program Manager will prioritize, implement, and lead the highest priority transformational initiatives across the Sales organization. This role requires a passion for shaping project strategy, buildingproject plans, centralizing processes, and optimizing change management. Successful candidates have strong analytical business acumen and an insatiable curiosity to understand and improve operations. 

We are looking for candidates who will champion, role model and embed Samsara’s operating principles as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with B2B hardware and SaaS products

Annual Base Salary

$102,042.50—$154,350 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
